about:
# Account Backup

**Alternative Backup Solution for Geometry Dash**

---

### About

Are you tired of being stuck on a saving loop from RobTop's cloud save or kept getting those <cr>Backup Failed</c>? Do you want an <cy>alternative way</c> to back up your <cg>Geometry Dash</c> account data on <cf>cloud</c>?

<cg>Look no further!</c> This mod provides an <cl>alternative account backup solution</c> by allowing you to back up your account data and your local levels to a custom backup server.

---

### Features

- Backup and restore your Geometry Dash account data to/from a custom backup server.
- Auto backup your account data every time you beat a level.
- Lots of QOL features that even the official cloud save doesn't have!
- Extra <co>512MB</c> of backup storage space with the <cp>**Account Backup Extra**</c> membership option! [**Subscribe**](https://ko-fi.com/arcticwoof)

---

### Self-Hosting

You can host your own account backup server by checking <cy>**[GDAltWebserver](https://github.com/DumbCaveSpider/GDAltWebserver)**</c> which is written in the <cc>Go Programming Language!</c>

---

### Ko-Fi Memebership

An optional <cp>Ko-Fi membership</c> is <cg>available</c> for <co>AUD$5.50</c> per month for those who wants extra **<co>512MB</c>** of backup storage space!

### Disclaimer

<cr>Use this backup mod as an alternative option, not as the main backup solution for your account!</c>
